scope: Acceptance of one natural-update parent interruption and operator-confirmed reconnection with same-candidate recovery
evidence_source: User-provided sanitized outputs from rehearse-auto-update-recovery.py; no independent authenticated provider query by agent

acceptance.interpretation: The helper accepted recovery of this interrupted campaign using its original candidate Build; this does not establish every interruption mode, an actual rollback exercise, automatic retention deletion, or billed savings

rehearsal.timestamp_interpretation: The reconnect timestamp records explicit operator confirmation; recovered_at records helper verification, not the exact Job promotion time

helper_acceptance_checks: The interrupted parent, campaign and candidate remain bound to the saved rehearsal
The same unique candidate Build and promoted checkpoint satisfy provider controls and signature verification
The approved source and complete live Job configuration match the expected image-only update
The baseline image becomes the rollback pointer and the resumed controller reports the matching reconciled marker
The final coordinator snapshot remains stable during recovery verification
evidence_limits: Cloud checks are reported by the user's helper output; the agent did not independently query GCP
Explicit reconnection confirmation does not establish a browser session or network-disconnection timeline
The controller's normal bounded cleanup path does not by itself prove any image was selected or deleted
Retained rollback metadata does not constitute an actual rollback exercise
No billed cost or savings were measured by this rehearsal
next_priority: Read back automatic image-cleanup selection, deletion and retention evidence without triggering another update
Observe actual project-filtered billed costs and credits in TWD
